description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 6150016115721 CABLE ASSEMBLY,POWE: Line 0001 Qty 1 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0063 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract). The Guaranteed Minimum quantity will be 1. Items will be shipped to various CONUS and OCONUS (via consolidation and containerization point) DLA Depots. Approved sources are 62144 20-2001; 75915 0217.125 P. The solicitation is an RFQ and will be available at the link provided in this notice. Hard copies of this solicitation are not available.
